extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: A large dataset for semantic-controlled video generation with over 100K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions. It provides curated samples for unified semantic-controlled video generation across categories such as concept, style, camera, and motion.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.publisher: ByteDance; The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We curated thousands of high-quality real images from the Internet and then used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases; paired videos generated from commercial model templates and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Human preference rate results of our user study.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Semantic alignment score evaluated by Gemini-2.5-Pro and GPT-5.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from commercial models and community LoRAs, so it may inherit stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations from those source templates.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Performance depends on caption quality and structural similarity between subjects; it degrades when descriptions diverge or subjects differ markedly. The dataset is synthetic, and the authors note that building a large real-world semantic-controlled video dataset remains a challenge. Multiple references can also cause the model to blend unwanted visual details across videos.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The collected reference images span men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Used for semantic-controlled video generation, including paired reference-target video creation and evaluation. The paper also describes a test subset with 24 semantic conditions sampled from four categories, with 2 samples each.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: We curated thousands of high-quality real images and used commercial APIs and LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates; for evaluation, we evenly sampled 24 semantic conditions from 4 categories in the test subset, with 2 samples each.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: We curated high-quality real images from the Internet and matched each image to compatible templates to form paired videos.
